skills.description: **Version 1.0.0** Supabase January 2026

skills.name: Use tsvector for Full-Text Search
skills.description: LIKE with wildcards can't use indexes. Full-text search with tsvector is orders of magnitude faster.

skills.name: Index JSONB Columns for Efficient Querying
skills.description: JSONB queries without indexes scan the entire table. Use GIN indexes for containment queries.

skills.name: Configure Idle Connection Timeouts
skills.description: Idle connections waste resources. Configure timeouts to automatically reclaim them.

skills.name: Set Appropriate Connection Limits
skills.description: Too many connections exhaust memory and degrade performance. Set limits based on available resources.

skills.name: Use Connection Pooling for All Applications
skills.description: Postgres connections are expensive (1-3MB RAM each). Without pooling, applications exhaust connections under load.

skills.name: Use Prepared Statements Correctly with Pooling
skills.description: Prepared statements are tied to individual database connections. In transaction-mode pooling, connections are shared, causing conflicts.

skills.name: Batch INSERT Statements for Bulk Data
skills.description: Individual INSERT statements have high overhead. Batch multiple rows in single statements or use COPY.

skills.name: Eliminate N+1 Queries with Batch Loading
skills.description: N+1 queries execute one query per item in a loop. Batch them into a single query using arrays or JOINs.

skills.name: Use Cursor-Based Pagination Instead of OFFSET
skills.description: OFFSET-based pagination scans all skipped rows, getting slower on deeper pages. Cursor pagination is O(1).

skills.name: Use UPSERT for Insert-or-Update Operations
skills.description: Using separate SELECT-then-INSERT/UPDATE creates race conditions. Use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT for atomic upserts.

skills.name: Use Advisory Locks for Application-Level Locking
skills.description: Advisory locks provide application-level coordination without requiring database rows to lock.

skills.name: Prevent Deadlocks with Consistent Lock Ordering
skills.description: Deadlocks occur when transactions lock resources in different orders. Always acquire locks in a consistent order.

skills.name: Keep Transactions Short to Reduce Lock Contention
skills.description: Long-running transactions hold locks that block other queries. Keep transactions as short as possible.

skills.name: Use SKIP LOCKED for Non-Blocking Queue Processing
skills.description: When multiple workers process a queue, SKIP LOCKED allows workers to process different rows without waiting.

skills.name: Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to Diagnose Slow Queries
skills.description: EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the query and shows actual timings, revealing the true performance bottlenecks.

skills.name: Enable pg_stat_statements for Query Analysis
skills.description: pg_stat_statements tracks execution statistics for all queries, helping identify slow and frequent queries.

skills.name: Maintain Table Statistics with VACUUM and ANALYZE
skills.description: Outdated statistics cause the query planner to make poor decisions. VACUUM reclaims space, ANALYZE updates statistics.

skills.name: Create Composite Indexes for Multi-Column Queries
skills.description: When queries filter on multiple columns, a composite index is more efficient than separate single-column indexes.

skills.name: Use Covering Indexes to Avoid Table Lookups
skills.description: Covering indexes include all columns needed by a query, enabling index-only scans that skip the table entirely.

skills.name: Choose the Right Index Type for Your Data
skills.description: Different index types excel at different query patterns. The default B-tree isn't always optimal.

skills.name: Add Indexes on WHERE and JOIN Columns
skills.description: Queries filtering or joining on unindexed columns cause full table scans, which become exponentially slower as tables grow.

skills.name: Use Partial Indexes for Filtered Queries
skills.description: Partial indexes only include rows matching a WHERE condition, making them smaller and faster when queries consistently filter on the same condition.

skills.name: Choose Appropriate Data Types
skills.description: Using the right data types reduces storage, improves query performance, and prevents bugs.

skills.name: Index Foreign Key Columns
skills.description: Postgres does not automatically index foreign key columns. Missing indexes cause slow JOINs and CASCADE operations.

skills.name: Use Lowercase Identifiers for Compatibility
skills.description: PostgreSQL folds unquoted identifiers to lowercase. Quoted mixed-case identifiers require quotes forever and cause issues with tools, ORMs, and AI assistants that may not recognize them.

skills.name: Partition Large Tables for Better Performance
skills.description: Partitioning splits a large table into smaller pieces, improving query performance and maintenance operations.

skills.name: Select Optimal Primary Key Strategy
skills.description: Primary key choice affects insert performance, index size, and replication efficiency.

skills.name: Apply Principle of Least Privilege
skills.description: Grant only the minimum permissions required. Never use superuser for application queries.

skills.name: Enable Row Level Security for Multi-Tenant Data
skills.description: Row Level Security (RLS) enforces data access at the database level, ensuring users only see their own data.

skills.name: Optimize RLS Policies for Performance
skills.description: Poorly written RLS policies can cause severe performance issues. Use subqueries and indexes strategically.
